description: Start a platform AI review of a branch's translations as a background job: each key × language pair gets a score and findings (accuracy, fluency, terminology, style, length, placeholders). Findings are warnings at most and never block a merge. Professional plan or higher, billed on its own AI review quota by the characters of target text reviewed – so scope it with `keys` / `langs` when you can. Needs the developer role. Poll ai_review_status; the findings then appear in get_qa_issues with source "ai". Errors: feature_not_available (plan), ai_review_quota_exceeded, ai_review_in_progress. Reviews the token's base branch unless `branch` names another allowed branch.

branch.description: Branch to operate on. Defaults to the token's base (bound) branch. May name any branch in the token's allowed set: its base branch, plus branches this token created (only when the token's scope is create-own; see list_branches). Naming any other branch fails with branch_not_allowed.

name: start_ai_review
title: Start AI Review
